segments.oily: One reviewer with very oily skin reports the pads help their skin feel nice and clean when used a couple of times a week.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the pads help eliminate flaking, and one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin reports a noticeable improvement without irritation.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports the pads brighten skin and help with blackheads without irritation.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who are fair-skinned or prone to redness, most often report no irritation and gentle, effective exfoliation, though a few describe stronger reactions such as increased sensitivity or breakouts when used too frequently.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal (including normal-to-oily) skin report smooth, radiant results without dryness or breakouts.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes the pads as excellent for aging skin, helping maintain texture and smoothness.

concerns.dehydration: Reports are mixed: some reviewers say the pads dry out skin or leave it feeling tight and flaky, especially with frequent use, while many others report no dryness and describe skin as smooth and hydrated afterward.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including some with sensitive or redness-prone skin, report no irritation, though a few describe temporary sensitivity, redness around the eyes, or skin becoming more reactive with daily use.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report the pads fade dark spots, acne marks, and discoloration, along with reducing the look of enlarged pores, typically within a few weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report the pads help clear breakouts and blackheads and reduce acne, including one who saw long-standing jawline acne resolve, though one reviewer with strong, easily irritated skin found it too harsh for daily facial use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with very oily skin reports the pads leave their face feeling clean without adding oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky residue after use
Citrus scent that some find too strong
Resealable jar keeps pads from drying out
Good value for the quantity of pads

extraits.titre: Yes I would buy this product again
extraits.texte: I have very dry skin and exfoliating with this product has helped eliminate the flaking that I used to see. The rep suggested that I cut the pads in half to extend the life of the product. Great tip.

I really love this product, I have very oily skin and this does help my skin feel nice and clean. I use it every other day, this will definitely be in my routine. I don't have any irritations,but I don't use it every day, I use it twice a week.

extraits.titre: Best exfoliating face pads for sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I have been using the Strivectin Daily Reveal Exfoliating pads in my daily skincare routine morning and at night. I have sensitive skin, and these pads do not irritate or make my face red. They are gentle enough, yet still are effective at clearing my pores. I noticed since I have been using these pads that my pores are minimized and I have less acne blemishes. Overall, I am super satisfied with this product, and I will continue to use these pads in my daily routine! Highly recommended!

I'm not sure if I appreciated the two-sided pads, one side is a micro-peel fiber pad for physical exfoliation, but I usually stick to chemical exfoliation since I find physical exfoliation a bit outdated. That said, these pads are effective for exfoliating, whether you prefer chemical or physical methods. I've been using this product once a day for a few weeks, and it hasn't irritated my skin, no burning, no redness, but I don't really have sensitive skin. My skin is combination and acne-prone, and I noticed these pads are brightening, and help with blackheads, improve my skin's overall appearance. My skin looks cleaner, brighter, and more even. I think these pads do a good job and live up to their claims. 60 pads is also a good value, will last for about 2 months.
